DISASSEMBLY OF PLANETARY GEAR OUTPUT SHAFT

1. REMOVE NO. 3 BRAKE DISC/PLATE PACK AND FRONT PLANETARY PINION GEARS

Grasp the components and pull off the front end of the output shaft.

Be careful to avoid dropping the bearing on the output shaft.

2. REMOVE THRUST WASHER FROM PLANETARY GEARS

NOTE: The thrust washer may have stuck to the inside of the planetary gear case.

3. REMOVE BRAKE DISCS AND PLATES FROM PLANETARY GEARS

4. REMOVE REACTION PLATE FROM PLANETARY GEARS
